descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S19 Scan time and which AI read the photo

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Each scan records which AI model read the photo, and logs the AI call time separately from the total (3.9, 3.5). (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5)
  • T3 Photo and census scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The 10 photos of S06 (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

When Each is scanned once through scanCensusSheet

Then Every call leaves an aiCallLog row with the model, durationMs and providerMs. The recorded model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex, not a placeholder. Calls over 30 s are listed for review

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per call, record the aiCallLog row (model, durationMs, providerMs), the ai_disclosure audit row's disclosed_to, and aiProvider:_current visionProvider / visionModel (read only). If model == 'vertex-configured-model', that is a U10 Fail ('model not recorded'): lib/phi.ts writes that literal when the aiProvider row has no visionModel. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S19

Scan time and which AI read the photo

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset photo10 (scripts/datasets/run.sh; rows prefixed QA DS1-photo10, deleted after: 2 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed). 10 synthetic census photos (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home; rendered by render-media.mjs because the S06 photo set is not on disk) were each scanned once from the list header scan sheet, which was then closed without adding anyone. After every call diagnostics:list held one vision.scanCensusSheet row with model gemini-3.6-flash (not the vertex-configured-model placeholder), durationMs 2281-4457 ms (median 3052) and providerMs on all 10 (the app adds 2-10 ms). No call over 30 s, so nothing to list for review. 20/20 judged cells held (U10, T3). Not checked: the ai_disclosure audit row (disclosed_to google_vertex) and aiProvider:_current need admin reads outside the dev allowlist, so 'on Vertex' is shown only by the logged model id. Every scan showed 'No patients / No residents found': that is the known B01, recorded, not part of this case.

Evidence: 1 attached; 2 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/photo10/evidence/TC-02-S19-hospital-after-scans.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/photo10/evidence/TC-02-S19-nh-after-scans.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
